choice: priority 1 — same model at a materially larger token count/resolution
why_this_choice: Lowest-friction path already supported by the repo: no port, no new checkpoint, same attention plumbing, same probe. Priority 2/3 (second Wan-family model, second modality) would each require verifying probe reach and token geometry for no additional inferential value on the token-count axis.

generalization_configuration.verified_by: geometry logged by the probe; ratio recomputed by f3b_analyze.py from the records themselves

token_count_note: Ratio is over actual token counts (32760 -> 75600). Do not confuse these with VSA's tile-padded length (39936 at 480p), which is a different padding for a different geometry and was mis-transcribed in an earlier draft of this file.
fp8_arm_caveat: At 720p the key-block count is 1182, not a multiple of 16, so torch._scaled_mm has no native kernel and arms R6/R7 fall back to an fp32 dot on FP8-rounded inputs. The records label those arms native_or_simulated='simulated' with score_semantics ending _FALLBACK_no_native_fp8_gemm, so the substitution is recorded rather than silent. Their FP8 *representation* is still genuine; only the dot is emulated.
changed: and therefore sequence length and block count
labelling: proxy generalization — this run uses the controlled proxy scorer (SCORER_PRECISION_ATTN), not VSA. Per F3B it must be labelled proxy generalization, not VSA generalization.
prompts_note: 5 first per F3B; expand to 10 only if clean
